exercises.question: Which sentence reports a statement correctly?
options: Marta dijo que no tenía tiempo. [Marta said that she had no time.]
Marta dijo si no tenía tiempo. [Marta said if she had no time.]
Marta dijo no tenía tiempo. [Marta said had no time.]

exercises.english: Marta asked if we wanted to have dinner.
He meant that he needed more time.

sentences: No entendí la instrucción. [I did not understand the instruction.]
Pedí una aclaración. [I asked for clarification.]
Después lo entendí todo. [Then I understood everything.]

exercises.question: Which expression asks for clarification?
options: ¿Puedes explicarlo otra vez? [Can you explain it again?]
¿A qué hora empieza la película? [What time does the movie start?]
¿Dónde vives? [Where do you live?]

exercises.english: It was quite an awkward misunderstanding.
What I mean is that we need to talk.

exercises.question: Which sentence tells a misunderstanding and how it was cleared up?
options: Pensé que estaba triste, pero explicó lo que quería decir y aclaramos el malentendido. [I thought she was sad, but she explained what she meant and we cleared up the misunderstanding.]
El lunes hablamos durante varias horas sobre la reunión y sobre el viaje de Ana. [On Monday we spoke for several hours about the meeting and about Ana's trip.]
El mensaje que me enviaste llegó tarde, pero lo leí por la noche con mucha atención. [The message you sent me arrived late, but I read it at night very carefully.]

exercises.sentence: Según Marta, el problema era otro.
options: According to Marta, the problem was different.
According to Marta, there was no problem.
Marta asked whether the problem was different.

exercises.sentence: Ahora entiendo lo que quiso decir Ana.
options: Now I understand what Ana meant.
Now I do not understand what Ana meant.
Now I understand what Ana asked.

exercises.english: He said he would arrive later.

options: Quiso decir que necesitaba ayuda. [She meant that she needed help.]
Quiso decir si necesitaba ayuda. [She meant whether she needed help.]
Quiso decir de que necesitaba ayuda. [She meant of that she needed help.]
Hablamos con él y le explicamos todo. [We spoke with him and explained everything to him.]
Hablamos con él y la explicamos todo. [We spoke with him and explained everything to her.]
Hablamos con él y les explicamos todo. [We spoke with him and explained everything to them.]
Significa explicar las cosas y preguntar cuando algo no está claro. [It means explaining things and asking when something is not clear.]
Significa hablar mucho y no escuchar a la otra persona. [It means talking a lot and not listening to the other person.]
Significa de que no hace falta explicar las cosas a otras personas. [It means of that there is no need to explain things to other people.]

exercises.question: Which statement best separates what a message seems to say from what the person meant?
options: El mensaje parecía negativo, pero la intención era diferente. [The message seemed negative, but the intention was different.]
El mensaje era negativo porque parecía negativo. [The message was negative because it seemed negative.]
La intención y el mensaje son iguales en todos los casos. [The intention and the message are the same in every case.]

template.prompt: Say that Ana said she was busy, but she meant that she could not come.
template.answer: Ana dijo que estaba ocupada, pero quiso decir que no podía venir.

template.prompt: Say that the best thing is to ask directly, explain the intention and clear up the problem.
template.answer: Lo mejor es preguntar directamente, explicar la intención y aclarar el problema.
